want. To wish to have or do something.
common. Happening often or to many people.
motivate. To make someone want to work hard.
balance. To give the right amount of time to two things.
quit. To leave your job or stop doing something.
increase. To become or make something bigger.
fire. To make someone leave their job.
policy. A set of rules that a company or group follows.
prepare. To get ready for something.
benefit. Something extra a worker gets, like health insurance.
